runtime_contract.service: existing Firebase callable describeScene in asia-east2; requires Google Auth, expectedUid, active profile and App Check
runtime_contract.provider: qwen3-vl-plus at Singapore QwenCloud endpoint; thinking disabled; non-streaming, max_tokens=512
runtime_contract.image: JPEG only, 512 KiB, width/height at most 1280, decode pixel bound; strip metadata
runtime_contract.bounds: 30 s upstream fetch/body, 32 KiB response, 40 s callable; transactional per-UID 45 s exclusion window and 20 attempts/UTC day
runtime_contract.cancellation: Local invalidation stops speech and suppresses late result; callable is not remotely cancelled; no automatic paid retry. Provider billing can continue after local timeout/cancel.
runtime_contract.result: Only complete stop + two or three full sentences, <=240 UTF-16 units and conservative content checks; rejected replies have no partial text
runtime_contract.telemetry: Capture and callable round trip measured separately; backend modelMs/usage/estimate; native TTS start event is not acoustic timing
runtime_contract.storage: No original image, full model reply, request body or Key persisted/logged. Latest safe backend metrics and bounded quota IDs under users/{uid}/private/sceneDescriptionLimit.
runtime_contract.price: Operator-configured per-million rates only. Missing usage/rates -> null. Estimate is not a billing cap. No US$5 budget configured.

not_executed.firebase_emulator: Not run: java -version reports no Java runtime. Firestore concurrency and rules need emulator/account verification; transaction seam tests are offline mocks.
